snippet.title: Retro Empire Free Demo Out Now | Retro Game Shop Simulator
snippet.description:
The free demo of Retro Empire is out now on Steam and itch.io!

Run your own second-hand video game shop: buy filthy old consoles from people around town, take them apart on your workbench, clean and fix them, and sell them in your own retro game shop. Fix up the arcade cabinet, swap its boards and play every game.

In the full game, hire staff to run the till and keep the shelves stocked, rent a second unit for your own arcade hall and open a cyber café.

▶ Free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5295010/
▶ Free demo on itch.io: https://danilop95.itch.io/retro-empire
▶ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5295010/
▶ Discord: https://discord.gg/jTNUNgB4GK
▶ Website: https://dvnsoftware.com/retro-empire
